enum: The Users section says who the users are
The form sends the booking to bookings@stillpoint.example
The page has a class booking form with the fields name, email, class and preferred date
The page must work on phones
The page shows the name Still Point Yoga and the address as text, with no embedded map
The weekly class list has five classes, each with day, time and price in rupees
